entities.name: Agnes of Aquitaine, Queen of Aragon and Navarre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Agnes of Aquitaine was a queen consort of Navarre. She was a daughter of William VIII, Duke of Aquitaine, and his third wife, Hildegarde of Burgundy.
